utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’m glad folks are helping out with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Glad to help. Send me the final list if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’ll send it over if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking on gloves, tape, and flashlights now—if we’re short, I’ll list exactly what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm whether we’re actually short on any of those, or are we good to start?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can’t confirm yet—I’m still checking the supplies list now. I’ll tell you right away what we’re short on and what we have enough of.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help, Rosa—just let me know what you need me to do this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — the repair drive’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll let you know what task would help most once I’ve got everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa—just keep me posted, and I’ll be there on Sunday ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, thanks, Hana. I just need help sorting the tools and loading them into the truck, around 9 tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you confirm the repair drop-off details first? I’m still waiting on the exact info before I jump in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure — once I have the exact drop-off details, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing, and where can I pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — you’re all set for sorting donations and setup at the community center. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Opal — just let me know if there’s anything else I should bring or prep.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can swing by Saturday morning around 10 and drop off supplies. If I’m running late, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds great, Bo—thanks for pitching in. Saturday at 10 works for me, and I’ll be ready for the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—I’ll see you Saturday around 10 with the supplies. If anything changes, I’ll send a quick update.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still a bit behind on the exact details, sorry. Want me to check with the others and get back to you?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, that’d help — I mostly heard it’s small fixes like patching cracks and tightening boards, and I can keep an ear out for more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira — that helps. I’ll check with the others and circle back once I’ve got the full details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Mostly the small practical fixes, right? Who’s coordinating the work this time?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s right—mostly small repairs like patching cracks, tightening boards, and fixing lights. I’m keeping the reminders going and letting everyone know we still need all the help we can get.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — are we still short on volunteers, or do you need donations too?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — if you can tell me what’s still missing, I can plan the route and avoid backtracking.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I think the main thing still missing is a clear list of drop-offs and who’s covering each stop. I’ll help spread the word about the community center deadline too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — that’s exactly what I needed. If you can send me the drop-off list, I’ll map the stops and keep the route tight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest on that repair drive yet. What’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I know Mara by the corner shop and Leon over on Cedar are still taking donations. If you want, I can point out the quickest route between them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’d be great—thanks. I’d love the quickest route between them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is happening soon—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — I can help coordinate around the school schedule if you can tell me when it’s happening. Then I’ll check with everyone and get back to you with the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure of the exact time yet, but I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear. Thanks for helping coordinate it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’m still checking the list, but I think a wrench set and some screwdrivers will do.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — just let me know if anything else comes up and I’ll see what I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’ll let you know if the list changes or if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. Let me know what you’d like me to coordinate first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center. Could you start with a list of what repairs you still need help coordinating?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I still need help coordinating small furniture fixes, a few loose cabinet hinges, and any basic patch-up jobs folks bring in. If anything else comes up, I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday morning around 10 still works for me — what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo — just bring gloves and a box for tools if you’ve got one. If anything changes, I’ll send the final list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring gloves and a box for tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll bring the screwdrivers and be there at 9 to help sort the tools and load the truck.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, that sounds helpful. I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re still on for 9, and I’m bringing the screwdrivers to help sort the tools and load the truck. If there’s anything else you need for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard it’s mostly small stuff—patching cracks, tightening loose boards, and fixing the lights. What do you still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That covers most of it. I just need someone to check the lights and help load the truck at 9.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help check the lights and load the truck at 9.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Saturday at 10 is still the plan, right? Just want to make sure we’ve got the repair drive started with enough gloves, tape, and flashlights.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, Saturday at 10 still works for me — I can coordinate around the school schedule. Thanks for checking, and let me know if you need anything else for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — I just wanted to confirm. Do we have enough gloves, tape, and flashlights, or should I bring a few more?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now—gloves, tape, and flashlights are the first things I want to confirm. If we’re short, I’ll let you know what we need to track down.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good — do you want me to help keep track of what’s missing so we don’t double back?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please — that would help a lot. I’ll check what we have, and you can keep a note of anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, Uli. I’m glad to help—just let me know what you need me to do for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you. If you can check the list and let me know the drop-off spot, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep asking for helpers and point them to sorting donations and setup at the community center. Just let me know if there’s anything else you still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’ve got the drop-off spot covered for now. If anything changes, I’ll send you the updated list right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll keep folks posted and direct anyone who asks to sorting and setup at the community center. Just send the updated list when you have it, and I’ll share it around.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — so it’s mainly cracks, boards, and lights, right? Are we still dropping donations off at Mara and Leon’s?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, that’s right — cracks, boards, and lights. And yes, we’re still dropping donations off at Mara and Leon’s, unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll keep to Mara and Leon for now. Do you know if they need anything specific, or just the usual donations?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — I’m still happy to help with the repair drive, and I can pitch in with sorting tools and loading the truck at 9.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be a huge help, Mara — the tool sorting and truck loading at 9 sounds perfect. If you’re heading over, I can still point you to who’s collecting donations.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, thanks, Tess — just point me to the donation folks and I’ll help out there too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is happening soon—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Rey — I’m a bit behind on the repair drive. I’ll check the list and see if I can grab the wrench set and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I can help keep track of what’s still needed if you want.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’m still waiting for the exact repair drive details before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No problem — just let me know when the details are set, and I’ll be there to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — I’m still waiting on the exact details, and I’ll let you know as soon as they’re set.
